title: Costco 在 2024 年调会员费，怎样把金额、时间和原因说清楚？
topic: 向会员解释费用变化、适用时间和会员权益

source.title: Membership Fee Increase
source.type: Costco 官方会员服务说明
source.context: 历史案例：Costco 2024-09-01 生效的会员费调整公告；本文复盘当时的旧价、新价和会员回馈上限变化。
paragraphs: Effective September 1, 2024, membership fees have increased.

Our membership fees help to offset operational costs so we can keep our prices low. A modest increase in fees will allow us to bring our members even greater value. To learn more about why we charge a membership fee, click here.
Effective Sept. 1, we also increased the cap on the Executive Membership 2% Reward from $1,000 per year to $1,250 per year.
translations: 会员费自 2024 年 9 月 1 日起上调。
会员费有助于抵消运营成本，让我们继续保持较低价格。适度调高费用将帮助我们为会员带来更多价值。
自 9 月 1 日起，行政会员 2% 回馈的年度上限也从 1,000 美元提高到 1,250 美元。
fullTextParagraphs: Effective September 1, 2024, membership fees have increased.
All Costco memberships will continue to include one free card for a designated member of the household who is 16 years of age or over.

Our membership fees help to offset operational costs so we can keep our prices low. A modest increase in fees will allow us to bring our members even greater value. To learn more about why we charge a membership fee, click here.
New members will be charged the new fee structure effective Sept. 1, 2024.
The fee increase took place beginning with September 2024 renewals, which members began receiving in mid-July.
Memberships that are auto renewed will be charged the new fee effective Sept. 1, 2024.
All Executive upgrades will be based on the new fee structure effective Sept. 1, 2024.
Effective Sept. 1, we also increased the cap on the Executive Membership 2% Reward from $1,000 per year to $1,250 per year.

notes.meaning: 自 2024 年 9 月 1 日起生效
notes.explain: effective + 日期用于说明新价格或规则何时开始适用。
notes.example: The updated service fee is effective January 1.

notes.explain: offset 表示抵消部分成本；这句话说明收费的用途，不是保证每项成本不变。
notes.example: The delivery fee helps offset transportation costs.

notes.phrase: increased the cap on the Executive Membership 2% Reward from $1,000 per year to $1,250 per year.
notes.meaning: 将行政会员 2% 回馈的年度上限从 1,000 美元提高至 1,250 美元
notes.explain: from A to B 清楚标出调整前后；金额范围不能省略。
notes.example: The annual allowance increased from $500 to $600.

scenario.title: 回复客户对服务费调整的疑问
english: A subscription service will raise its annual plan from $80 to $86 on October 1.
The company says the fee helps cover support costs while keeping the monthly price unchanged.
Write a reply that gives the amount, effective date, and reason without promising an unlisted benefit.
chinese: 一家订阅服务将于 10 月 1 日把年费从 80 美元调至 86 美元。
公司表示费用用于承担客服成本，月付价格保持不变。
写一条回复，说明金额、生效日和原因，不承诺公告中没有提到的权益。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请根据 Costco 2024 年 9 月的调价公告写三句话：说明普通会员费怎样变化、何时生效、调价原因，以及行政会员回馈上限怎样变化。
firstAttempt.sample: Effective September 1, 2024, Gold Star and Business memberships increased from $60 to $65 per year. Membership fees help offset operating costs so Costco can keep prices low. The annual cap on the Executive Membership 2% Reward increased from $1,000 to $1,250.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先报这次调价的新旧金额与生效日，再说明公告中的费用用途，最后补充行政会员权益变化。

output.sample: Effective January 1, the annual membership fee will increase from $240 to $252. The fee helps cover the cost of maintaining our facilities. Existing members will continue to receive two complimentary classes each year.
